declarations.description: A notification card. Use c2-toast-region to manage stacking, queueing and timed dismissal.
declarations.name: Toast

slots.description: Leading icon, with a variant-specific SVG default.
slots.name: icon

slots.description: Custom action content, replacing the action-label button.
slots.name: action

members.name: message
members.description: Plain-text message; the default slot can replace it.

members.name: heading
members.description: Optional title above the message.

members.name: variant
members.description: Semantic icon variant.

members.name: noIcon
members.description: Hides the leading icon and removes its space from the layout.

members.name: showProgress
members.description: Displays a countdown bar. Managed toasts receive progress from their region.

members.name: progress
members.description: Remaining fraction from 0 to 1. Standalone cards display this value without starting a timer.

members.name: dismissible
members.description: Shows a keyboard-accessible dismiss button.

members.name: actionLabel
members.description: Label for the optional action button.

members.name: closeLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

members.name: managed
members.description: Set by a region to prevent duplicate announcements.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Requests dismissal. Standalone toasts are hidden; a region removes managed toasts.

events.name: toast-close
events.description: Dismiss requested by the close button or Escape; detail contains reason.

declarations.description: Fixed notification stack with a FIFO overflow queue and independent visible lifetimes.
declarations.name: ToastRegion

members.name: position
members.description: Viewport corner or center edge at which notifications appear.

members.name: maxVisible
members.description: Maximum visible notifications; the rest wait without running their timers.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible region name.

members.name: inline
members.description: Inline layout for embedded notification stacks.

members.name: enterAnimation
members.description: Entrance effect. Directions describe movement: slide-down enters from above.

members.name: exitAnimation
members.description: Exit effect. Directions describe movement: slide-right exits toward the right.

members.name: animationDuration
members.description: Entrance and exit duration in milliseconds. Zero disables animation.

members.name: showProgress
members.description: Shows a remaining-time bar on timed notifications by default; set false to hide it.

members.name: controller
members.default: new ToastController( (toast, reason) => { this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toast-dismiss', { bubbles: true, composed: true, detail: { id: toast.id, toast, reason } })) }, (toast) => this.animateExit(toast.id), )

members.name: queuedCount
members.description: Number of notifications waiting for a visible slot.

members.name: count
members.description: Number of visible and queued notifications.

members.name: show
members.description: Adds a notification or updates the one with the same ID. Returns its ID.

members.name: updateToast
members.description: Updates content in place and restarts its visible lifetime.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Removes a visible or queued toast.

members.name: clear
members.description: Removes all visible and queued notifications and cancels their timers.

members.name: pause
members.description: Pauses all visible timers until resume is called.

events.name: toast-action
events.description: Action activated; detail contains id and toast. The toast is then dismissed.
A toast was removed; detail contains id, toast and reason.
